description: Ground truth for evaluating the memory-audit loop against the playground. In leaky mode (default) every scenario below must be found with the right category; in ?mode=fixed the audit must report zero findings.

scenarios.fix: Stop retaining replaced nodes in the module-level array; let removed DOM be garbage collected
Pass an AbortController signal to addEventListener and abort on tooltip close (or removeEventListener)

scenarios.action: Create then discard the polling widget repeatedly
scenarios.fix: clearInterval when the widget is discarded
Bound the cache (LRU eviction) or key it weakly

scenarios.action: Add panels then 'Remove all panels', repeatedly
scenarios.fix: Call observer.disconnect() when panels are removed and drop observer references

scenarios.action: Navigate away from #spa-views and back, repeatedly (route cycle)
scenarios.fix: Unsubscribe the bus listener in the view's unmount/teardown
